It is nothing more than a thin crust of the real world floating on the edge of the insanity that is [[Abaddon]]'s prison. Beyond this gate, the forces of Abaddon must not be allowed. If the gate is sundered by the dark god, his evil will pour forth onto the world unabated.}} The [[Gate of Torment]] is the one point in the [[Realm of Torment]] that connects to [[the Desolation]] on [[Elona]] and the last line of defense preventing [[Nightfall (event)|Nightfall]] from occuring. ==Getting there== The [[Ruins of Morah]] mission must be completed to gain access to this location.
